purpose: Audit stored internal links in a supplied blog inventory and propose editorial link candidates.
steps: Export published stored links with the WordPress helper or prepare a JSON inventory.
State coverage and omissions before interpreting incoming links.
Separate distinct incoming pages, link occurrences, unresolved internal targets and external outbound domains.
Review no-observed-incoming candidates against omitted navigation, hubs and other content.
Review lexical link candidates in context and choose useful anchors; do not insert automatically.
Repeat the same audit after authorized edits and retain the before/after evidence.
limits: Internal incoming links are not external backlinks.
Missing targets are unresolved, not confirmed HTTP failures.
No fixed link quota, mandatory title/H1 inequality or keyword-density target.
Topic clusters are declared; suggestions use lexical overlap, not semantic certainty.
The WordPress export omits navigation, dynamic shortcode output and synced-block expansion.
